answer_1.quote: Although abstractive summarization systems have improved dramatically in recent years, these models still often include factual errors in generated summaries.

answer_2.quote: we evaluate several SOTA factual consistency metrics on our benchmark, namely DAE, QuestEval, SummaC-ZS, SummaC-Conv and QAFactEval. We also benchmark recent ChatGPT-based evaluation metics

answer_3.quote: We also benchmark recent ChatGPT-based evaluation metics from and. ChatGPT-ZS and ChatGPT-CoT prompt LLMs to directly output a binary factuality decision. On the other hand, ChatGPT-DA and ChatGPT-Star ask LLMs to score the factuality of generated summaries on a scale of 0-100 and 1-5 respectively.
